svg.title: Fixed explicit-rating fit, validation selection, and retained test failure
svg.desc: G has no test curve: four validation checkpoints choose epoch 200 before the test file is opened. H compares the same 24/8/8 observed rating events for each model. Eight users are shared across splits; bars are finite deterministic metrics without iid confidence intervals. MF uses more parameters, and its test RMSE remains worse than the global mean. No online or human outcome is measured.
